q: Shannon's capacity of the noiseless channel with forbidden symbol sequences (the Shannon capacity of a graph G, Θ(G)) for the 5-cycle C₅ was computed by Lovász (1979) using the theta function:
exp: Lovász theta function: Θ(C₅) = √5. This equals the independence number α = 2 raised to the Shannon capacity power: the zero-error capacity of the channel with confusion graph C₅ is ½ log(√5) = ¼ log 5 bits. Shannon's original work left this open; Lovász solved it with the semidefinite theta function.
